name: Bubble Raycasting
summary: A ray-casting variation that integrates a bubble mechanism to improve 3D target acquisition in virtual reality.
howItWorks: The user points toward the target with a ray. Instead of selecting only the exact ray intersection, the system applies a bubble-like selection region around the ray to determine the most likely target.
advantages: Selecting small, dense, or difficult-to-point-at targets in VR when standard ray-casting requires too much precision.
limitations: The bubble mechanism can introduce ambiguity when several targets are close to the ray or fall within the adaptive selection region.
